title: InternReviewer & InternAdvocate: Objective Reward and Evaluation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning in Peer Review and Rebuttal
abstract: arXiv:2608.28612v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generating professional scholarly content, such as peer reviews and rebuttals, requires an intricate synergy between domain reasoning and factual grounding. This work presents a comprehensive framework for the development and evaluation of specialized scholarly agents, InternReviewer and InternAdvocate. We first establish a large-scale, high-quality scholarly dataset and integrate a high-efficiency arXiv retrieval tool to enable active evidence gathering. To optimize these agents, we implement an agentic Reinforcement Learning (RL) paradigm driven by a unified objective metric and reward system. translated_title: InternReviewer 与 InternAdvocate：面向同行评审与反驳中智能体强化学习的客观奖励与评估
translated_abstract: 生成专业的学术内容（如同行评审意见和反驳意见）需要领域推理与事实依据之间精密的协同。本工作提出了一个用于开发和评估专业化学术智能体 InternReviewer 与 InternAdvocate 的综合框架。我们首先构建了一个大规模、高质量的学术数据集，并集成了高效的 arXiv 检索工具，以支持主动的证据收集。为了优化这些智能体，我们实现了一种由统一的客观指标与奖励系统驱动的智能体强化学习范式。该系统通过采用多维评价标准，避免了基于主观模型评判所带来的偏差，这些标准包括以参考文献为锚点的语义对齐、结构合规性，以及一种严格的验证机制——该机制通过实时交互日志对引用进行交叉核验，以消除幻觉。实验结果表明，智能体……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了 InternReviewer 与 InternAdvocate 两个学术智能体，通过以参考文献锚定语义对齐、结构合规与引用实时交叉验证等多维客观标准构建奖励系统，驱动强化学习训练，从而生成无幻觉、高质量、客观的同行评审与反驳内容。
en_tdlr: Presents InternReviewer and InternAdvocate, scholarly agents trained via agentic reinforcement learning with an objective multi-dimensional reward system—featuring reference-anchored semantic alignment, structural compliance, and real-time citation verification—to generate high-quality, hallucination-free peer reviews and rebuttals.
